findings.before: CapabilityStateProvider consumed /capability/bootstrap batching but did not own an AbortController for the bootstrap request.
findings.after: CapabilityStateProvider now aborts replaced, unauthenticated, route-changed, and unmounted bootstrap loads.

findings.before: ModuleAccessProvider already derived from CapabilityStateProvider and did not make independent /modules/me calls.
findings.after: The existing derivation remains unchanged; request fan-out remains centralized in capability bootstrap.

findings.before: Dashboard used Promise.allSettled and updated state only after all startup requests settled.
findings.after: Dashboard starts independent requests and commits each result/error separately without waiting for all requests.

findings.before: Jobs used the default frontend request timeout and blocking list error state.
findings.after: Jobs list uses 15000ms timeout, one retry, request cache, and cached/empty fallback.

findings.before: The target endpoints relied on normal auth/RBAC and repository execution only.
findings.after: Read-heavy target endpoints have session-scoped burst throttling and duplicate in-flight request rejection.
